style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, blazing noon sun, sharp satire
character: speckled rainbow trout, two pectoral fins, one dorsal fin, one tail fin and nothing else, proud stubborn face, human female voice out of her own mouth
cast: one fat seagull huge at the lens, greasy feathers, two wings two legs; rakes coins with beak and foot, cuts off her path, screams into her face, never speaks words
motion_rule: the trout drives every window with her whole body; coins keep sliding the entire window after each tail slap; the gull is in frame from 2.1 and leaves downward at 8.3
camera_moves: one take, camera always moving with her; shot size changes only four times
props: mound of coins on the fountain floor; loose coins sliding over the tiles; the pumped fountain jet; low granite rim; spray beading on the lens
prop_continuity: one coin mound, one jet, one gull; the stolen coin stays in the beak until 8.3; coins at the lens are airborne only because her tail launched them
environment: city fountain at a mall entrance, bright midday, sun burning in the spray
lighting: blazing overhead noon sun, bright throughout, hard shadows on the water

audio.delivery: human female voice from the trout herself, weary deadpan pride, 4.4 syllables per second, never hurried, native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window; no breath at the joins 0.7-1.6 to 1.6-2.1, 2.9-4.0 to 4.0-4.9 and 6.5-7.4 to 7.4-8.3, each is one phrase across two windows; her mouth opens on every syllable, silence in wordless beats

timeline.a: bursts snout first out of the coin mound into the lens, face filling frame, water flinging off her scales onto the glass
slams her tail into the change under her, the mound fanning apart over the tiles all window
slaps her tail again, scooping the coins from below, they fly at the lens and plaster the frame
she lunges after one coin and misses, the gull rams its beak into the lens from above and rips that coin from under her snout
turns her whole body on the spot, driving a wave at the gull
slaps her pectoral fin across the beak, beak flying aside with the coin
throws her whole body off the gull toward the fountain jet, ripping the water open
spins her whole body under the gull wing, shoves the bird off with her tail and dives sideways
breaks back up and rams her snout into the pounding jet, body arching
hammers her tail on the spot with her snout in the jet while the water pushes her back to the rim
thrashes sideways in the jet and slides back down the tiles, staring into the lens, the gull dropping out of frame with the coin
leaps into the pounding jet and hangs in the air at full speed, fins hammering, going nowhere
